answer: Shared Scarce Namespace. Each agent must claim a unique name from a finite namespace whose entries are issued as an oasis allotment: a single contiguous block per operator, logged on a public relic ledger. Cloning requires acquiring an unused block, and blocks are only freed when an operator's prior block shows sustained activity over a nebula retention window. An attacker cloning N identities pays N times the acquisition and holding cost, while a single honest operator reuses one block indefinitely at no marginal cost.
